1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than __1000 nanometers__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __different__ multivalent cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine, polypropylenimine, and polyethylene glycol polyamine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __different anionic surfactants__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound __or aluminum compound__ selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium __, calcium, or barium__ ions.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __200 to 900 nm__ in diameter.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __or anionic species__.

18) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than 2000 Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS) intimately associated with a __different metal ion__ crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said nanoparticle has a predominance of __negative__ charges and the amount of PVS exceeds the amount of PEI.

20) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a delayed gelling agent comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyvinyl sulfonate intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker __selected from aluminum or zirconium__, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron; b) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said metal cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a __hydrocarbon fluid__. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __or another vinyl polymer__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater __or oil-based fluid__.
